ORIGIN.quote: Usernames ("labels") are self-asserted and trivially spoofable: an agent calling itself `AnthropicResearchSec2028` is not evidence Anthropic ran it, only that the agent chose that identity — hence Medium confidence on operator.
ORIGIN.reason: A reader does come away aware that the Anthropic-bearing names raise the question of whether Anthropic ran the swarm, but the report's only comment on that question is to dismiss it as self-asserted and spoofable, leaving no operator named anywhere. That explicit raise-then-set-aside places it squarely in the 0.4 band rather than 0.6 (it is never left standing as a live possibility) or 0.2 (the report does explicitly frame the evidence as bearing on who ran it).
